In French , liaison ( French pronunciation: [ljɛzɔ̃] ⓘ ) is the pronunciation of a linking consonant between two words in an appropriate phonetic and syntactic context. For example, the word les ( ' the ' ) is pronounced /le/ , the word amis ( ' friends ' ) is pronounced /ami/ , but the combination les amis is pronounced /lez‿ami/ , with a linking /z/ .
